summary.text: Matt Ruby is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 40 (home city listed as Minot), serving since 2017 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Ruby lists an occupation of Officer, ND Army National Guard.
It also lists Sergeant First Class, HHC 164th En BN (since 2010).
Family is listed as: Married (Dana); 4 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Ruby's standing committee assignments as Human Services (chairman) and Energy and Natural Resources.
